content.short: API for Cardano decentralized blockchain. Accessing and processing information stored on the blockchain is not trivial.
content.description: API for Cardano decentralized blockchain. Accessing and processing information stored on the blockchain is not trivial. We provide abstraction between you and blockchain data, taking away the burden of complexity, so you can focus on what really matters - developing your applications. Our basic tier is and always will be free of charge. We nurture development and the Cardano ecosystem. However, if you want to support us, please consider upgrading. We run, build, love and deeply care about open-source.
content.meta: Blockfrost provides hosted API infrastructure and blockchain data access for Cardano developers. Explore Blockfrost on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Calidus Pool Keys: Secure SPO Interaction on Cardano
resources.tldr: Stake pool operators previously had to touch cold keys to prove who they were. Explains the delegated key scheme that removes that, and why it matters operationally.

resources.title: IceBreakers: How SPOs Earn Revenue by Decentralizing an API
resources.tldr: API infrastructure is a genuine centralisation point that rarely gets discussed. On paying independent operators to run it, and whether the incentives actually hold.

resources.title: IceBreaker Spotlight: Building Lace Pool
resources.tldr: A stake pool operator's account of moving from design work into running infrastructure. Worth reading for the unglamorous reality of node operation.
